G001.target_statement: Search a specific topic by keyword in the relevant subreddit (for example the city subreddit for Halloween) to get information about that topic.
G001.label: direct
G001.rationale: 原句明确以关键词在相关 subreddit 搜索特定话题并取得信息，主体、对象、方式一致；例句中的 city subreddit 与 Halloween 保留为情境例，未升格为固定业务目标。

G002.target_statement: Browse the feed of followed subreddits during downtime to pass time and find something interesting to read, with no predefined outcome for the session.
G002.label: direct
G002.rationale: 三处原句分别支持消磨时间、滚动信息流直到发现感兴趣内容、以及碎片时间的适用条件；同时保留“没有预定目标/没有特定结果”的否定限定，未把它改成任务型目标。

G003.target_statement: Turn to technical help or code-query subreddits for other input when stuck on a problem, as an alternative to Stack Overflow.
G003.label: direct
G003.rationale: 原句明确说明在卡住或需要其他输入时使用技术类 subreddit，并明示其定位是 Stack Overflow 的替代，主体、条件与方式均保留。

G004.target_statement: Get targeted answers grounded in other people's personal experience to the specific problem at hand, faster than a generic Google search, so that the problem gets solved.
G004.label: direct
G004.rationale: 原句同时给出目的（针对当前问题的结果）、依据（个人经历优先且被认为可信）、比较基准（比 Google 搜索更快省时）与结果（问题被解决）；四项均有直接原句，未加入原文没有的阈值。

G005.target_statement: Reach the relevant posts directly by Googling the question with 'reddit' appended, when the search target is specific.
G005.label: direct
G005.rationale: 原句明确描述以 Google 加 reddit 关键词取得相关帖子并直接打开的方式，属原文明确选定的实现方式，按其自身内容保留为独立目标。

G006.target_statement: Create an advice-seeking post in the relevant community with a title, a Markdown body and any tags the subreddit makes mandatory, so that the members who filter on those tags answer it.
G006.label: direct
G006.rationale: 原句给出发布求助帖这一核心动作，并明确社区选择、标题与正文、以及部分社区强制标签的条件与目的（标签让合适成员筛选并回应）；操作步骤作为同一动作的组成保留，未机械拆成多个目标。

G007.target_statement: Rely on strongly moderated communities — auto-moderator bots that fact-check and alert human moderators, plus human moderators who remove low-quality posts — as the basis for treating posts as reliable.
G007.label: direct
G007.rationale: 原句直接给出可靠性判断的条件（审核团队强）与机制（自动审核机器人核查并向人工版主告警、人工版主清理低质帖），并保留“并非 100% 可靠”的限定，未把它扩大为零误差要求。

G008.target_statement: Use Reddit, including the news subreddit, to stay updated on trends.
G008.label: direct
G008.rationale: 原句明确“do use reddit to stay updated on trends”，主体与目的直接一致；范围按原句限定为 trends，未扩写为全部时事。

G009.target_statement: Keep news out of Reddit and use other apps as the primary news source, because Reddit is used to satisfy curiosity rather than to follow news.
G009.label: direct
G009.rationale: 原句为明确的取舍与否定（把新闻排除在 Reddit 之外、以其他应用为主要新闻来源），并给出理由（Reddit 用于满足好奇心而非新闻）；保留否定方向，未改写成“多用 Reddit 看新闻”。

G010.target_statement: Research products and services on Reddit to get a balanced perspective from people of varied backgrounds before making a purchase decision.
G010.label: direct
G010.rationale: 原句说明在 Reddit 上做产品调研以取得平衡、多元背景的视角，并说明其已影响多次购买决定；比较对象（电商评价多为好评）作为理由保留在条件中。

G011.target_statement: Search general health questions on Reddit, including AskDoctors where healthcare professionals answer, for topics such as beginner yoga routines.
G011.label: direct
G011.rationale: 原句明确 Reddit 适合一般健康问题，并给出 AskDoctors 由医疗从业者回答与新手瑜伽示例；“不专门关注健康社区、按需搜索”的条件一并保留。

G012.target_statement: Avoid relying on Reddit for specific health problems, and do not recommend it to others for those.
G012.label: direct
G012.rationale: 原句为双重否定式表达（具体健康问题不用、也不建议他人使用、不信任具体健康内容），保留否定与不推荐的对象范围，未扩大为否定全部健康用途。

G013.target_statement: Match the feed view to the activity: compact view when actively searching so that all relevant results are visible before choosing one, and card view when passively scrolling.
G013.label: direct
G013.rationale: 原句分别说明主动搜索时偏好紧凑视图（先看到全部相关结果再点开）与被动浏览时偏好看板视图；保留为有条件的偏好，未升级为强制或统一默认。

G014.target_statement: Keep the reading experience ad-free by using a browser ad blocker, since the inline ads are judged subtle and non-blocking.
G014.label: direct
G014.rationale: 原句明确“无广告体验更好”并使用浏览器广告拦截器，同时保留对现有广告“不破坏阅读、位置固定、数量少”的评价；未把广告描述为严重障碍。

G015.target_statement: Buy the premium tier when ad blocking is not available, since removing ads is its only advantage.
G015.label: direct
G015.rationale: 原句为带条件的购买意愿（广告拦截不可用时购买），并说明唯一好处是去广告、当前有拦截器所以不需要；条件与强度按原样保留为意愿而非承诺。

G016.target_statement: Save an in-progress post as a draft on mobile when leaving it mid-way, as is possible on desktop.
G016.label: inferred
G016.rationale: 原文明确陈述移动端无法保存草稿、桌面端可以，并称其为 frustrating；据此推断希望移动端具备草稿保存能力，原文未出现“希望/应该”字样，故支持标签为推断，缺失的能力本身即为推断依据。
assumptions: 把明确的挫败陈述与桌面端对照视为对该能力的正面期望

G017.target_statement: Follow comment threads clearly on mobile, to the clarity that the desktop version provides.
G017.label: inferred
G017.rationale: 原文明确说移动端无法直观跟踪评论、桌面端展示更清楚，属比较性不满；由该不满与对照推断希望移动端评论线索同样清晰，原文无直接请求句式，故记为推断。
assumptions: 把比较性不满视为对移动端评论线索清晰度的改善期望

G018.target_statement: Improve the mobile app so that it is fast, intuitive and lightweight and remains the best app for the platform instead of trailing third-party wrapper apps.
G018.label: direct
G018.rationale: 原句直接要求移动端 UI 应明显更好、应改进移动应用，并给出慢、笨重、不直观与第三方封装应用份额更高的理由；强度“should be much better”保留，未写成必须达到具体指标。

G019.target_statement: Add a generative-AI tool that returns the exact subreddit for a given question, so that the question is posted where responders know the subject matter and the answers are better.
G019.label: direct
G019.rationale: 三处原句构成提议（加生成式 AI 工具找准确 subreddit）、实现方式（输入描述给出目标 subreddit）与预期结果（回答者更懂主题、答案更好），并保留“坏回答无法完全消除”的限定。
